stanza: You lost the search for Agartha
You’re lost up your own ass
You're lost in the oil rainbow’s blue purple shine
Lost in bad poetry
Lost in logic
Lost in a racist bourgeois town

poetry.line: I get down to Beat poetry
stanza: Well, my boyfriend's in a band
He plays guitar while I sing Lou Reed
I've got feathers in my hair
I get down to Beat poetry
And my jazz collection's rare
I can play most anything
I'm a Brooklyn baby
I'm a Brooklyn baby

poetry.songTitle: There She Goes, My Beautiful World
stanza: John Wilmot penned his poetry
Riddled with the pox
Nabokov wrote on index cards
At a lectern, in his socks
It's goodbye to all my friends
It's time to go again
Think of all the poetry
And the pickin' down the line
Well, I'll miss the system here
The bottom's low and the treble's clear
But it don't pay to think too much
On things you leave behind

poetry.line: There ain't no money in poetry
stanza: There ain't no money in poetry
That's what sets the poet free
I've had all the freedom I can stand
You got your cold dog soup and rainbow pie
All it takes to get me by
Fool my belly till the day I die
Cold dog soup and rainbow pie

poetry.line: At a Buddhist monastery writing horny poetry
stanza: Leonard Cohen once said
"There's a crack in everything, that's how the light gets in"
And I am not an old man having an existential crisis
At a Buddhist monastery writing horny poetry
But I agree
You need me like the wind needs the trees to blow in
Like the moon needs poetry
You need me

poetry.linePrev: As I hide behind these books I read
poetry.lineNext: Like art could save a wretch like me

poetry.line: Louise only got from me innocent poetry
stanza: Louise only got from me innocent poetry
Although she played to not listen
But still I can hear myself speak as if no one else
Ever could offer the same
The poetry
It's not lost on me
I'm left asking
How it found me
The poetry
It's not lost on me
I walk around alone
Laughing in the street
